.@NEVHC's WIC program is one of many WIC programs that help families access the resources they need for a healthier life, including food vouchers, nutrition education, and healthcare referrals.

I will work to secure funding for NEVHC so it can continue providing valuable services to our community.

I am honored to welcome San Fernando Valley native @SenatorMenjivar to President Trump's Joint Address to Congress.

As a fighter and advocate, Senator Menjivar advanced policies to protect the health and welfare of all communities – including immigrant communities, the LGBTQ+ community, and low-income communities.

I wrote to @USACEHQ for answers to the wildfire cleanup process, including:

- How the debris will be stored and transferred through CA-29
- How transporting and storing debris will impact public health and the environment
- The role of third party contractors in this process

Prioritizing public health and the environmental impacts this would have on our community remains the one of my top priorities.

As a result of their haphazard, short-sighted, and illegal mass firings of the federal science workforce, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and DOGE put the public health of Americans, the safety of our communities, and our innovation and global competitiveness at risk. 

I co-sponsored 5 bills from my @sciencedems colleagues to put a halt to the chaotic mass firings.

By refusing to test the soil in wildfire-impacted areas, FEMA is breaking a precedent and harming the long-term health of our communities.  

I joined @RepFriedmanCA and our Southern California Congressional colleagues in demanding FEMA prioritize the safety and wellbeing of all residents in the aftermath of the recent wildfires.

https://t.co/6yttClxRBD

Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and @HouseGOP's budget plan will cut Medicaid for millions of Americans – including many of the 83,000 patients who relied on @NEVHC for care last year.

I spoke with NEVHC CEO Kim Wyard in Van Nuys about the importance of protecting Medicaid in our communities.

The L.A. area has the most polluted ozone in the country, and it is negatively impacting public health in communities like Pacoima and Sun Valley.

Republicans have 3 proposals to strip California's leadership toward a cleaner and healthier future.

I am voting no on all of them. https://t.co/BN8gOomihl

It's just past 10 pm in D.C. and @NRDems and I are continuing to fight back on House Republicans' bill that will:

❌ Give Big Oil another tax break
❌ Sell our public lands to the lowest bidder
❌ Further harm the public health of our Black, Brown, Indigenous, and poor communities

The Trump White House removed the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool, a key website that helped disadvantaged communities facing the greatest environmental, health, and economic burdens.

My amendment in @NRDems makes sure the communities most burdened by pollution, poverty, and underinvestment are not erased from federal policy decisions.

.@TakedaPharma’s warehouse in Van Nuys produces plasma-derived therapies for the treatment of rare, chronic, and genetic diseases.

I visited their warehouse to learn more about the production and distribution process of these treatments and how they help communities. https://t.co/ZkOlWE1p1D

El Centro de Amistad in San Fernando provides culturally sensitive mental health and social services to families across CA-29.

I stopped by their office today to thank them for their work in the community and to help erase the stigma around seeking help for mental health.

Remember, the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline is available 24/7 at no cost to anyone experiencing a mental health crisis.

Whether Donald Trump and his Administration likes it or not, our job as Members of Congress is to shine a light on their actions and hold them accountable.

My colleagues and I will continue to exercise our oversight duties to protect our most vulnerable from this Administration's harmful policies. (cc: @RepJimmyGomez, @NormaJTorres, @RepLouCorrea)

.@SenAlexPadilla was doing his job and demanding answers from an Administration that has failed to answer any questions about its treatment of our most vulnerable.

Americans watched in horror as this Administration quickly resorted to violent actions to silence Senator Padilla, erase our democracy, and rewrite our nation’s values.

I will fight with my @HouseDemocrats to protect Medi-Cal, which allows patients to receive care at places like the Therapeutic Living Centers for the Blind in Reseda.

This Disability Pride Month, I visited TLC to learn more about the work they do to support those with disabilities across the Valley.

The San Fernando Valley deserves to have clean air to breathe and a climate free from pollution. 

I joined @USRepKCastor and @RepPaulTonko in urging the EPA to REJECT its rollback of greenhouse gas emissions standards and protect public health in communities like ours.

Read the full letter in the link in my bio.

School is back in session at Sylmar Biotech Health and Engineering Magnet School as well as Sylmar High School. 

Our CA-29 educators have exciting plans for students to succeed this upcoming school year. 🌟

And to help out, I donated books from the Library of Congress! https://t.co/8k4lpsBNIQ

Team Rivas joined Valley Community Healthcare in North Hollywood to learn about the services they are providing for our constituents here in CA-29.

21,000 patients rely on VCH for care. Republicans' Big Ugly Bill slashes the programs, services, and care VCH provides.

This Senior Citizens Day, @HouseDemocrats and I are highlighting the importance of protecting healthcare for all seniors in the San Fernando Valley and across the country.

I’m back at Adelanto to conduct oversight of the facility and perform a wellness check on Benjamin Guerrero-Cruz from Reseda.

ICE transferred Benjamin from Adelanto to Arizona and then back to Adelanto without notifying his family.

That is unacceptable, and I’m here to demand answers.

Trump and @HouseGOP want to let polluters harm the public health of environmental justice communities like the San Fernando Valley.

Because of Republicans' bill, millions will see their premiums soar – or even lose their care all together.
